payout_quote: Earn a $1,200 bonus: Deposit at least $25,000 in new money within 30 days of opening your new Platinum Business Checking Package. You must maintain at least $25,000 balance for 60 days after account opening and complete six qualifying transactions within 60 days. Promo code: Q3DIR26. Offer valid through September 27, 2026. Earn a $400 bonus: Deposit at least $5,000 in new money within 30 days of opening your new Business Essentials account. You must maintain a $5,000 balance for 60 days after account opening and complete six qualifying transactions within 60 days. Qualifying transactions include: Debit card purchases, ACH and wire credits or debits, Zelle credits and debits, U.S. Bank mobile check deposit, electronic or paper check debits, U.S. Bank bill pay for business (excluding payments made by credit card) and payment received via U.S. Bank Payment Solutions. You'll receive your bonus 30 days following the last calendar day of the month after you have met the qualifications. Your bonus will be paid out directly to your new U.S. Bank business checking account.
payout_value_note: Two tiers of one campaign: $400 (Business Essentials) or $1,200 (Platinum). Offer ends 9/27/2026 - within 14 days of this check; tax treatment not stated on page, taxable interest per standard rules.

steps: Open a new U.S. Bank Platinum Business Checking Package (for $1,200) or Business Essentials account (for $400) by 9/27/2026 - promo code Q3DIR26 is applied automatically.
Deposit at least $25,000 (Platinum) or $5,000 (Essentials) in new money within 30 days of opening and maintain that balance for 60 days.
Complete 6 qualifying transactions (debit purchases, ACH/wire, Zelle, mobile check deposit, bill pay) within 60 days.
Receive the bonus in the account 30 days following the last calendar day of the month after all qualifications are met.
timing: Bonus deposited within 30 days after the month-end in which all offer requirements are met; offer ends 9/27/2026 - expiring within 14 days of this check.
